items.t: What Is Novartis (SWX:NOVN) Gaining From Its PMR Approval And ADC Deal?
items.sum: Novartis (SWX:NOVN) reported US FDA approval of Cosentyx as the first anti IL 17 biologic for polymyalgia rheumatica. The new Cosentyx indication targets patients with polymyalgia rheumatica who currently rely heavily on long term steroid treatment. items.t: Novartis Targets 5% Annual Sales Growth Through 2031 Despite Patent Expirations
